defectsFoundAndFixed: Token normalisation initially stripped punctuation, merging K10 with K10+ (two different Kessler instruments). Fixed to flatten case and spacing only; regression test pins it.

The Australian Prescriber article was added to the ledger; the acquisition gate refused it because its publisher is registered catalogueIdentityOnly and registering it would alter retrieval selection. Withdrawn rather than registered.

Fifteen sources were initially reported as blocked on the authority register. Re-checked: their publishers (AIHW, Healthdirect) are registered and ledger-eligible, and the block came from the offline planner's conservative default rather than the real gate.
nice-delirium was recorded as an identity conflict. Resolved on the facts: two chapter URLs of one NICE guideline, not two sources.

resumePoint: Thirty sources read from their publishers; eight admitted. What remains divides cleanly: clinical judgement on the drafts, three owner decisions about the source register (review-dated pages, 21 publishers, host policy), and six pages that need a browser. None is work this session can do without changing a protected surface.

publisherReads.note: Dates read from publishers' own pages. Review, update, effective and publication dates recorded as the different events they are; none substituted for another.

structuralBlocker.finding: Australia's most-used official clinical web sources publish a review date, not a publication date. Healthdirect stamps a review month; WA Health's consent article stamps a review day; the WA Chief Psychiatrist registers and the WHO mhGAP page carry no date at all.
structuralBlocker.effect: acquisitionLedgerIssues requires publicationDate for every non-rejected record, so 13 governed WA, national and WHO sources cannot be registered even though their metadata was read successfully.
structuralBlocker.whyNotFixedHere: Relaxing the mandatory field is the weakened schema the field policy forbids. The honest alternative, a distinct state requiring a real review date, changes the clinical source register's contract and is the owner's decision.
structuralBlocker.readingBanked: establishedReviewDate on each affected record, so the reading is not repeated.
